Name: Cabins as Sheds
Author: CherryChain
Description:
[b]Notice: I am not actively supporting this mod anymore, though it is a simple CP mod and shouldn't ever break as long as Content Patcher still works. As an alternative, consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]Upgrade Empty Cabins[/url]﻿, which allows you to upgrade uninhabited cabins in single-player as well as remove the seed boxes in the cabins[/b]


Adds a 10x9 space to basic cabins on top of the existing space.

[u]You will gain the additional space to your cabins after your second house upgrade.[/u] It's basically three free sheds, so it feels a bit too much for early game.

[b]This is meant for singleplayer![/b] Things will def get funky if a farmhand tries to live in one of these and upgrades it

Why use cabins in single player:
[list=1]
[*]They're pretty much free
[*]More visual variety in buildings rather than having a bunch of sheds that look the same
[*]Add a sleep+save point at different places on your farm ( good for big maps )
[*]The dresser is a free chest ( and gives extra tools while yours are being upgraded at Clint's)
[/list]
Honestly I just threw this together real quick for myself, but it's the first time I've made a mod that doesn't heavily rely on other people's work so I can actually post it. Hope someone else finds this useful too!
